description: Install and configure Capacitor for Android, update Vite config for Capacitor compatibility, configure native plugins, handle Android back button, set up status bar/splash screen, and add Capacitor npm scripts.
steps: Create capacitor.config.ts in project root with: appId 'com.aurelix.app', appName 'Aurelix', webDir 'dist', server config for development (url pointing to local dev server with cleartext enabled), plugins config for SplashScreen (autoHide, launchShowDuration, backgroundColor matching dark theme #08070f), StatusBar (style dark, backgroundColor #08070f), Keyboard (resize 'body', style 'dark')
Update vite.config.ts: add `base: './'` to the config object so assets load correctly from file:// protocol in Capacitor WebView. Keep the existing server config for dev mode.
Run `npm run build` to produce the dist/ directory needed for cap add
Run `npx cap add android` to scaffold the android/ directory
Run `npx cap sync` to sync web assets and plugins to the android project

Create src/lib/capacitor.ts utility file that: imports { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core', exports `isNativePlatform()` function (returns Capacitor.isNativePlatform()), exports `getPlatform()` function (returns Capacitor.getPlatform())

Create src/hooks/useBackButton.ts hook that: imports App from '@capacitor/app', imports useNavigate and useLocation from react-router-dom, listens to 'backButton' event on native platforms, navigates back if history available or minimizes app if at root route ('/' or '/feed')
Create src/hooks/useStatusBar.ts hook that: imports StatusBar and Style from '@capacitor/status-bar', on mount sets status bar style to Dark and backgroundColor to #08070f on native platforms
Create src/hooks/useNativeApp.ts that combines useBackButton and useStatusBar into a single hook to call from App.tsx

Update src/App.tsx: import and call useNativeApp() hook inside the BrowserRouter (needs to be inside router context for useNavigate). Add a small NativeInit component that uses the hook and renders null, placed inside BrowserRouter.
Update package.json scripts to add: 'cap:sync': 'cap sync', 'cap:open': 'cap open android', 'cap:build': 'vite build && cap sync', 'cap:run': 'cap run android'
Update index.html: ensure the viewport meta tag includes 'viewport-fit=cover' (already present), and add a meta tag for Capacitor: <meta name='format-detection' content='telephone=no'>
acceptance_criteria: capacitor.config.ts exists with correct appId, appName, webDir, and plugin configs
android/ directory exists with valid Android project structure (app/build.gradle, AndroidManifest.xml)
src/lib/capacitor.ts exports isNativePlatform and getPlatform utility functions
src/hooks/useBackButton.ts handles Android back button navigation correctly
src/hooks/useStatusBar.ts configures status bar for dark theme
App.tsx uses the NativeInit component inside BrowserRouter
package.json has cap:sync, cap:open, cap:build, cap:run scripts
npm run build succeeds with all changes
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit code 0 (build succeeds with base: './')
Run `npm run test` and confirm exit code 0
Confirm android/ directory exists with `ls android/app/build.gradle.kts` or `ls android/app/build.gradle`
Run `npx cap sync` and confirm exit code 0
